findings.topic: Generated header output strings escape live-capacity admission
findings.proof: headerOutput creates `${prefix}${header.display[index]}\n` before Writer.text. Writer.text retains that text across awaits but only the encoded byte array is held. The new 2/UTF16-unit string is neither pre-admitted nor charged while coexisting with header/name/display and encoded result. This violates logical capacity even if the JS engine uses ropes, and is not an RSS assertion.

staticLedger.meaning: Source arithmetic, not observed allocation. 160 = scanner32 + row32 + cell32 + header32 + name-entry32. It is a lower bound excluding any other uncharged bookkeeping. Earlier sanitize join is 24736+32+8192=32960. During encode, text remains live; required 24736+4097+8194=37027. Static path predicts admission despite excess required capacity; runtime confirmation belongs to executor.

findings.topic: Cooperative yield can exceed 65536 charged work units
findings.proof: work checks an already-aborted signal but does not yield. In quoted selector scanning, doubled pairs continue before checkpoint; 65537 pairs therefore execute 65537 work calls with no checkpoint. Header whitespace trim loops also call work without checkpoint, and wildcard mismatches can return before matches' checkpoint while the outer loop has none. Awaiting resolved lookup promises is not the setImmediate cooperative yield required by the implementation's own mechanism.
